mapper.insert: insert into osh_question_answer_user_question_follow (user_id, question_id, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, delete_flag) values (#{userId}, #{questionId}, now(), #{createBy}, now(), #{createBy}, 0) on duplicate key update delete_flag = 0, update_time = now(), update_by = #{createBy}
mapper.select: select question_id from osh_question_answer_user_question_follow where user_id = #{userId} and delete_flag = 0
